nodes.long_description:
MuralView2 is a mixed reality visualization tool built for mural artists, designers, and clients. Import your artwork and place it directly onto real-world walls through Meta Quest, giving you a true sense of scale, placement, and composition before the first drop of paint hits the wall.

Move, scale, rotate, mirror, and adjust your artwork while standing in the actual space. Fine-tune opacity and positioning to visualize how a mural will interact with architectural features and the surrounding environment.

Shared Vision takes mural planning further by allowing multiple Meta Quest headsets to view the same mural placement together in the same physical space. Artists, assistants, and clients can walk around the project and experience the proposed mural from different viewpoints at the same time.

Whether you’re planning a large commercial mural, presenting a concept to a client, or working out placement before painting, MuralView2 helps bridge the gap between a digital design and the finished wall.

Plan it. Place it. See it before you paint it.

Use this for the Short Description:

Visualize your mural before you paint it. MuralView2 lets artists import artwork and place it directly on real-world walls in mixed reality. Scale, position, rotate, adjust opacity, and preview designs at true scale using Meta Quest. Shared Vision lets multiple headsets view the same mural placement together, making it easier to plan, present, and collaborate with clients.

nodes.change_log:
MuralView2 2.2 — headset 398

WHAT'S NEW

CORNER AND WARP POINTS ALWAYS GRAB
In TRANSFORM, the balls on the corners, edges and warp grid now grab every time, at any size, from across the room or right up close. Each ball has a grab zone all the way around it, in front, behind, above, below and to the sides. On a picture smaller than 8 feet wide and tall, that zone is the size of the ball. Once the picture is 8 feet wide or tall, it grows to 10 inches around each ball, so even a huge mural is easy to reshape. Before, the balls on a big picture could stop responding entirely.

ANOTHER PICTURE BEHIND NO LONGER GETS IN THE WAY
A picture already on the wall only blocks a grab when it sits in front of the ball, not behind it.

RECONNECT MESSAGE
If your headset ever needs to be linked to your muralview2.com account again, the app tells you: open LIBRARY for your headset code and type it at muralview2.com. Your pictures stay safe.

ALSO
Includes the hinge improvements from 394.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

MuralView2 2.2 — headset 394

WHAT'S NEW

HINGES ARE EASIER TO HIT
In DRAW, the laser now stays on when you point just past the picture, up to about 6 inches outside the frame. The hinges sit right along the edge, so you can always see where you're aiming as you line one up. Point anywhere else and the laser still tucks away so it never gets in front of your drawing.

YOU CAN SEE THE CLICK
When you click a hinge, it changes to the pinned color and pops right away, while you're still pointing at it. Click it again to free it and it changes back. No more moving off the hinge to check if it took.

THE HINGE ONLY SWINGS ON ITS HINGE
With an edge pinned, the picture only swings around that edge. On a left or right edge, push the stick left or right. On a top or bottom edge, push it up or down. A crooked push no longer twists the picture off its hinge. The hinge follows the picture's own edge, so it works at any angle, ramps included.

ALSO
The hinge colors follow each launch's color scheme, matching the control panel.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

MuralView2 2.2 — headset 391

WHAT’S NEW

LAYERS SHOW UP ON THEIR OWN
Open a picture with layers and its layers window pops up right under the control panel, tipped toward you like a desk under a monitor. It follows the panel wherever you move it, and closes and opens with it. The rows are big and easy to hit. Tap X to tuck it away for a moment; it comes back when you pick a picture or change mode. DELETE only shows up once you’ve chosen two or more layers.

A STEADIER LASER
The dot at the end of the laser no longer jumps around. The control panel and your picture always come first, and the dot glides across walls instead of hopping between near and far.

HELP WHEN SOMETHING’S OFF
Tap the ? next to ABOUT for a list of common problems. Tap one to see the fix. SCAN THIS ROOM opens Quest’s room setup, and OPEN QUEST PERMISSIONS takes you straight to the permissions page.

A BETTER START
The welcome page now starts with a short checklist for setting up your headset, with the same two buttons.

EASIER HINGES
In DRAW, the hinges on the frame light up when you point at one. One quick click of the trigger pins an edge or frees it. No more double-tap, and no more nonstop buzzing.

ALSO
PSD pictures show up to 5 layers.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

MuralView2 2.2 — headset 390

WHAT'S NEW

HINGE THE PICTURE ON AN EDGE
Lining up a long wall is now easy. In DRAW, point at any edge of the frame and double-tap the trigger to pin it like a hinge. The controller buzzes when you're on an edge, and a line in the grab color shows which one is pinned. Then tilt as usual and the picture swings open from that edge like a door, at whatever angle it sits, while the pinned edge stays put. Walk to the far end and lay it flat. Double-tap the same edge again to free it.

FINER TILT AND SPIN
Tilting and spinning are slower and smoother, so you can set the picture to a hair. A light push barely moves it, and a quick flick is a tiny nudge. Click the stick in for the fast speed.

TILT GOES STRAIGHT
Tilting now sticks to up, down, left, or right. Pull a little off to the side and it still tilts straight. A diagonal happens only when you aim right at it.

FORCE VERTICAL AND FORCE HORIZONTAL STAY TRUE
Force vertical is always exactly plumb and force horizontal is always exactly level, even after you take the headset off and put it back on. With an edge pinned, the edge stays where it is.

SHARED VISION: YOUR OWN PICTURE
Once someone joins, each of you has your own picture. Moving yours never moves theirs. Each of you can slide, push in or out, fade, spin, tilt, hinge on an edge, force vertical, and force horizontal. Size and shape stay as they were. Your own moves stay put when you take the headset off and put it back on.

ALSO
The X for deleting a picture in the library is bigger and easier to hit with either hand.
The edge of the control panel no longer blocks buttons near it.
Illustrator SVG files now show their true colors, and open without a pause.
Big uploads from the upload page pick up where they left off if the connection drops.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.

MuralView2 2.2 — headset 389

WHAT'S NEW

PICTURE FIRST
PLACE, TRANSFORM, and DRAW stay grayed out until you have a picture up. Tap one before that and LIBRARY opens so you can pick one. Once a picture is up they stay lit, even while you go back to the library for another.

TRANSFORM ON ONE SCREEN
Every TRANSFORM tool is now on one screen: FREEFORM, UNIFORM, DISTORT, WARP, DOME, FOLD, CURVE, CORNER, LAYERS, and ADJUST. No more digging through folders. FOLD, CURVE, and CORNER open their line options, and BACK brings you straight back to the tools. SETTINGS is now called ADJUST (flat, flip, and turn).

FIND YOUR PICTURE FAST
Scrolled through the library and lost the picture you're working on? Grab it on the wall and the library jumps back to it, so you can close it out right away.

ABOUT
A new ABOUT button under the uploads window tells you who made MuralView2, with links to my website and my other Apple apps.

Controllers only. English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese.
